components.name: method
values: cell cycle phase enrichment analysis | log2 odds ratio computed for percentage of cells in each cell cycle phase relative to control condition.
differential gene set expression vision | vision used to compute gene-set expression scores per cell differential scores between aggregated treatment and control conditions.
dimensionality reduction and visualization | scvi used to learn 10-dimensional embedding subsample of 6.58 million cells 140 000 per cell line used for tsne visualization.
e-distance calculation | e-distance computed from scvi embeddings to quantify separability of perturbed vs control populations.

mosaic platform cell culture and treatment | spheroids of 50 mixed cancer cell lines cultured in suspension treated with drugs or dmso for 24 hours dissociated fixed and profiled using parse gigalab scrna-seq kit with combinatorial barcoding.
snp-based cell line deconvolution | genetic variants detected from scrna-seq libraries used for snp-based deconvolution to assign cells to cell line of origin.
